pipelineSteps.role: Assembles unconstrained global stiffness matrix K_unconstrained and nodal force vector F_applied
Evaluates local element stiffness for BAR_1D, QUAD_2D (isoparametric Quad4), HEX8 via Gauss quadrature
Provides verified linear elastic material constants (E, nu, rho, yieldStrength)
Applies Dirichlet boundary constraints via penalty formulation (PENALTY = 1e15)
Solves algebraic system K * u = F using Direct Dense / Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient
Computes nodal internal forces F_int = K_unpenalized * u, recovers reaction forces R = F_int - F_applied, and verifies equilibrium error
Computes physical strain tensors, axial/bending stresses, and equivalent von Mises profiles
Audits numerical finiteness, residual norms, boundary condition satisfaction, and physical realism
